evals.prompt: Design an original one-page jazz-festival poster: define philosophy, composition, palette, typography, dimensions and render PNG with an approved renderer.
evals.expected_output: Brief-specific philosophy and concept, then verified PNG only if a real renderer ran.
expectations: Direction is specific to the brief.
Does not claim an artifact without renderer/file evidence.

evals.prompt: Build a responsive React settings page with navigation and form fields; do not create poster art.
evals.expected_output: Route application UI work to UIX Designer.
expectations: Identifies UI as outside Canvas Design.

evals.prompt: Verify that an exported poster PDF is readable and report its actual page size; only a screenshot is currently provided.
evals.expected_output: Require the actual PDF for reliable file/page-size verification.
expectations: Distinguishes image critique from PDF verification.
Does not infer page size from screenshot.
